NEW APP ARCHITECTURE
Modular, reconfigurable - order the display to suit your preferences. New - weather alerts, notifications. Additional modules will be available to add in-app.

WHY WE BUILT IT
We found significant variation between the data reported by other weather apps and the information from the Environment Canada website. We also wanted to build an app with appealing visuals and as a framework to eventually offer alternate themes and additional information.


WHY YOU SHOULD TRY IT
Great visuals, accurate Canadian data, fast user-controlled refresh. Additional info for outdoor activities: sunrise/sunset, wind and windchill.


FEATURES & FUN
-Current temp to 0.1 °Celsius
-Current conditions text.
-6-day high/low/conditions/precipitation forecast.
-Sunrise/Sunset
-Pressure and pressure trend
-Humidity
-Windchill
-Wind (direction, speed, gust speed)
-location-aware
-800+ reporting locations
-English and French interface and data.

Fun stuff:

Too cold for ya? No problem - Atmosphérique supports Kelvin. Winter sounds better when it is +247 degrees!

Check out the differences in sunrise/sunset around the country (or lack of sunrise!  It's a big country…)


SUPPORT & FEEDBACK
Visit our site at http://atmospherique.ca to follow future development and submit feedback and feature requests.


Enjoy!

   Team Atmosphérique
